# Audio credits

Every recording in this folder is mono, 32 kHz, cut from the source named below, high-passed at 32 Hz, peak-normalised and
encoded as MP3 (`test/audio_pack.py` is the exact recipe: source URL and cut points for every clip). In the game they are
pitched, time-bent, layered and mixed with synthesised sound (`src/view/audiohybrid.js`); none is played back as it is.
Licences were read from the page each file is served from (Wikimedia Commons file page, OpenGameArt page, archive.org item page and the README
inside its download). Nothing here is non-commercial or share-alike.

## Looked at and not used

For the huff/snort (2026-11): NPS Yellowstone "Bison eating" (public domain; its one snort is low and buried in grass noise), the Acoustic Atlas horse
snorts (CC BY-NC-ND), Wikimedia Commons giraffe snorts and bison grunts (CC BY-SA), the Commons "X sound effect.wav" uploads by Zagzav12 (CC0 but
their origin cannot be checked), an archive.org "horse-sound-effects" item (marked CC0 but re-uploaded from sites with their own licences), and a
humpback "wheezeblow" hydrophone recording (public domain, but the blows are buried in water noise). For the sniff: Commons "Lion sniffing at the ground"
(CC BY-SA); the Red Library has no sniff takes (dogs: panting only).

OpenGameArt/Commons clips with share-alike or non-commercial licences, a grizzly "roar" from the NPS Yellowstone library (public domain
but almost all wind noise), and the gorilla grunts/snarls whose chain of origin could not be checked.
